stories.headline: Quest v72 update: faster hand tracking, glance-to-connect PC
stories.subtitle: Look at a PC and tap Connect for Remote Desktop; more stable hand cursor and passthrough keyboard tracking. The update is rolling out now to Quest headsets.

stories.headline: Gen 3 in stores at $449; camera-free Audio ships Oct 13
stories.subtitle: Gen 3 adds Aviator, Zena, a slimmer build and longer battery at $449; the $349 camera-free Audio line — no camera at all, for the privacy-conscious — ships Oct 13.

stories.headline: Quest 3 512GB ~30% off via Meta's eBay storefront
stories.subtitle: IGN flags the deal during the October Prime Day period — well under the $599.99 retail price; it's sold direct from Meta's eBay storefront, so check the listing at checkout for final terms.

stories.headline: Dutch backlash grows: hospitals told to bar camera glasses
stories.subtitle: Dutch hospital association NVZ advises keeping the devices out of hospitals; eyewear chain Hans Anders halted sales at 400 stores over filming fears. Part of the wider European privacy push against camera glasses.

stories.headline: Anti-smart-glasses detector apps go mainstream
stories.subtitle: Popular Science spotlights apps like Nearby Glasses and ZuckOff that scan Bluetooth to warn when camera glasses are nearby. Detection isn't guaranteed — glasses with Bluetooth off won't show up — but it's the clearest sign of the backlash going mainstream.
